claims.claim_text: As of January 31, 2026, Kohl's operated 1,153 Kohl's stores. In 2025 there were two new store openings (Item 1 Business / MD&A). In 2024 the company closed 27 underperforming stores and one e-commerce fulfillment center (San Bernardino, CA); in 2025 it closed the Monroe, OH e-commerce fulfillment center.
claims.rationale: Store-count + planned-closure cadence is a HIGH-tier retail-distress signal. Calibration Heuristic 11 applies: verify net store-count trajectory against announced closures.

queries.purpose: Macerich (MAC) mall-REIT tenant disclosure — does landlord disclose Kohl's as tenant?
Simon Property Group (SPG) mall-REIT tenant disclosure

claims.claim_text: Net sales decreased $610M, or (4.0%), to $14.8B for fiscal 2025, driven by ~4% decrease in transaction volume. Sales decreased across all merchandise lines except Accessories (+2.0%). This is a multi-year comp decline.
claims.rationale: Comp-store-sales trajectory is the central retail-distress signal. Calibration Heuristic 9 applies: test for inconsistencies between marketing-tier claims and financial-statement notes.

queries.purpose: Hanesbrands (HBI) — does this top apparel supplier mention Kohl's as a top customer (10%+ exposure)?
Levi Strauss (LEVI) — wholesale customer concentration mention
VF Corp — does VFC disclose Kohl's as a wholesale customer?

claims.claim_text: In 2025, Moody's downgraded the corporate credit rating from Ba3 to B2 (and senior unsecured B1 to B3); S&P downgraded from BB- to B+. The interest rate on the 3.375% notes due 2031 has increased a cumulative 175bps since issuance via coupon adjustment provisions. The Company issued $360M of 10.000% senior secured notes due 2030 in 2025, a distressed-grade coupon.
claims.rationale: Calibration Heuristic 10 (Layer 3 Rule 10): credit-rating downgrades, springing financial covenants, and 10% senior secured note coupon are direct distress markers.

queries.purpose: External mentions of Kohl's in any 10-K/10-Q (counterparty asymmetric mention test)
Self-corroborate the high-yield senior secured note coupon

claims.claim_text: Kohl's private label and co-branded credit cards are owned by an unrelated third party (Capital One per the 2022 Amended and Restated Credit Card Program Agreement, Exhibit 10.13). Kohl's shares net risk-adjusted revenue. Other revenue decreased $84M in 2025 due to lower credit revenue partly from servicing shift to Capital One.
claims.rationale: Credit-card partner is a material counterparty for KSS. Calibration Heuristic 7: Capital One's 10-K should mention Kohl's if program is material.

queries.purpose: Capital One (COF) — does COF disclose Kohl's credit program as a partnership?
Self-disclosure consistency of Capital One relationship

claims.claim_text: At year-end 2025, Kohl's had a Sephora at Kohl's shop-in-shop presence in over 1,100 of its stores: 855 full-size 2,500 sq-ft Sephora shops + 294 small-format Sephora shops = 1,149 locations. Accessories (which includes Sephora) was the only segment to grow in 2025 (+2.0% to $3.122B).
claims.rationale: Sephora partnership (LVMH-owned) is the only bright spot in the merchandise mix and a top-line stabilizer. Test for asymmetric self-promotion vs operational reality (Heuristic 3).

queries.purpose: External mention of the Sephora-Kohl's partnership

claims.claim_text: Operating lease ROU assets of $2.338B and operating lease liabilities of $2.744B ($94M current + $2.650B long-term) at January 31, 2026. Finance leases & financing obligations of $2.450B ($85M current + $2.365B long-term). Total lease + financing-obligation balance-sheet footprint of ~$5.2B (vs $4.05B shareholders equity).
claims.rationale: Calibration Heuristic 12: lease portfolio is a structural balance-sheet risk that often gets understated in marketing-tier disclosure. Total off-debt lease liability exceeds book equity.

claims.claim_text: Senior secured ABL revolving credit facility contains a SPRINGING financial covenant relating to fixed charge coverage ratio. As of January 31, 2026, Kohl's was in compliance with all covenants. No outstanding borrowings under $1.5B revolver at fiscal year-end. Cash $674M vs $134M prior year.
claims.rationale: Calibration Heuristic 10: covenant compliance + liquidity profile is core distress marker. Springing covenant means it only tests if availability falls below a threshold — common in distressed structures.

queries.purpose: Test for absence of going-concern flag (Layer 3 Rule 10)

claims.claim_text: Recent management turnover: J. Ashley Buchanan joined as CEO via November 22, 2024 offer letter / January 15, 2025 employment agreement, replacing Thomas Kingsbury (May 2023 employment agreement). Cooperation Agreement with activist Macellum Badger Fund signed February 2, 2023. Pattern: activist intervention -> CEO change in 2023 -> another CEO change in late 2024 / early 2025.
claims.rationale: Management churn at the CEO level twice within 2 years post-activist is a governance instability marker for retail distress. Heuristic 3 applies: transformation plan execution.
